analyst.summary: Pfizer India is a financially conservative, debt-free MNC pharma subsidiary with a consistent dividend track record, but its branded-formulations business is growing only slowly, reflecting slower new-product introductions from the global parent and pricing/competitive pressures typical of MNC pharma units in India. A meaningful part of reported profit also comes from investment income on the company's cash balance rather than the core pharma business. We rate it a Hold: safe and cash-generative, but not a growth story.
